pullRequest.title: Place the Inventory doll from its part placements and draw the experience bar
pullRequest.body:
Closes #227

The menu doll is the rig's idle frame: the 15 male part clips match `stand` frame 1 of `model1_animations.json` to under 0.001 in every matrix entry, mirrored in x at 1.3075. Part origins match within 0.03 px, except `arm1`, which sits 1.0 px right and 1.0 px up. The port's static `REST_POSE` is not that frame: `hand2` is turned 180 degrees, and `hand1`, `arm1`, `leg2`, `leg3` and `weapon1` are 10 to 30% smaller. Julian chose to keep the existing doll code, so the doll is not changed. Its union rect is 0.89 px off on the left and 0.98 px off on the right, which passes the 1 px limit by 0.02 px.

- Added a `doll` piece to the rect record. `extract_screen_rects` fits the scale and position from the 31 clips and records the union rect of the unequipped male doll.
- Moved the `Doll` into the scene. `EquipDollView.setup` keeps a `Doll` it finds there, and the Store still builds its own.
- Removed `DOLL_POSITION`, `DOLL_SCALE` and `EXP_FILL` from `inventory_window.gd`, and the three hand-cut exp textures.
- The experience row is the left box, the `xp_bar` fill, the gloss and the percent, all in the record. The width of the full bar comes from `menu_math.json`.
- The percent rounds like the original's `Math.round`.
- The doll now faces left, as the SWF places it.

The port draws no ground shadow (shape 143, the 31st clip). Decisions, guesses and gaps: https://github.com/julian-perge/urchin/issues/227#issuecomment-6947874455

Review decisions: https://github.com/julian-perge/urchin/issues/227#issuecomment-6948145769

Checked: `just gut` (877), `just pytest` (618) and the prek hooks pass. The new tests fail when I break the percent rounding, the fill scale or the median in the doll fit. I looked at windowed renders at 0%, 38% and 100% experience.
